text:
sara: Heads up — bringing up reranker v2 (fp16 -> PTQ int8). Quick holdout run shows -0.04 NDCG@10 and -0.02 MRR@10. Curious if priming length / candidate ordering could be the cause.

miguel: Can you paste the eval command + dataset? which holdout split exactly?

sara: Holdout is prod-sampled-100k (mixed query lengths). Command I used: `./eval.sh --model rerank-v2-int8 --k 10 --dataset prod-sample-100k --seed 42`. Logs: https://paste.redwood/reports/362345 (summary in the logs).

noah: Two quick suspects: tokenizer/priming token differences and candidate truncation/concat separator changes. Did we change the separator tokenization between versions?

sara: We changed doc concat separator from "\n\n" to " <SEP> " in the ingestion pipeline for v2. Also priming uses an extra `__PRIME__` token (64-token pad) in the new preprocessing. I toggled prefix caching off in this run; result still negative.

miguel: Let's try a targeted probe. Normalise whitespace + revert separator to old style, and force deterministic candidate order. Quick snippet to normalise: 
```
# normalise candidate text on the fly
python -c "import sys, json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); d['doc_text']=d['doc_text'].replace('\n',' ').strip(); print(json.dumps(d))"
```
Then run the same eval. Also run with `--no-candidate-shuffle`.

sara: I'll run three variants: (A) baseline v2-int8 as before, (B) normalized whitespace + old separator, (C) force stable candidate ordering + strip priming tokens. ETA ~30m.

noah: Also generate tokenizer seqlen histogram to see distribution shift: `python tools/seqhist.py --dataset prod-sample-100k --tokenizer rerank-v2` — if v2 tokenizes longer on average that could amplify quantization error.

miguel: If B recovers most of the gap, we can add formatting preproc to the bringup checklist before signing off the quant config. If not, try disabling top1 gating during eval (calibration change).

eval-bot: Run started: eval-harness job 84621 (variants A,B,C). Artifacts: https://console.redwood/jobs/84621. ETA ~28m.

sara: :thumbsup: kicking off now, will post delta when done.

sara: Update: runs finished. Variant B (whitespace normalise + old separator) recovered +0.035 NDCG@10 relative to A (so only -0.005 net vs fp16 baseline). Variant C recovered +0.012. MRR@10 follows same pattern (~+0.018 for B). So separator + whitespace are the dominant contributors.

miguel: Nice, that strongly implicates formatting change. Plan: add a small preproc step to restore old concat behavior for bringup, then re-run full PTQ smoke. Also file an onboarding checklist item so future bringups run standard preproc by default.

noah: Agreed. Also add a unit check in eval harness: when formatting parity is enforced, NDGC delta between fp16 baseline and quant must be <= 0.01 on the smoke holdout. That'll catch regressions that are actually formatting-induced.

sara: Created ticket INF-2345: "reranker v2 bringup — enforce formatting parity preproc + eval guardrails". Attached minimal repro and the exact eval flags.

miguel: Thanks — once preproc patch is in, let's re-run the quantization pipeline and update the model card.

sara: Will do. Also adding a short note in the bringup doc about "priming token padding" differences so teams don't accidentally change pad tokens without re-evaluating.

noah: Good call. Leaving this thread as the repro trail. If anyone wants the raw artifacts ping me and I'll share a trimmed CSV.
